name: Charm Studies
source:
Charm Studies is a lo-fi picross game about young witches studying magic.
You play as Cassia, an airheaded girl who's currently failing charms class... Luckily, Senna has agreed to tutor her! The only problem is she's not very nice... Can these two little witches learn from each other through the magic of puzzles?

[From [url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/charm-studies]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Charm Studies是一款关于年轻女巫学习魔法的低保真绘图方块游戏。
你扮演卡西娅，一个头脑简单的女孩，目前魔咒课没及格……幸运的是，塞纳同意辅导她！唯一的问题是她不太友善……这两个小女巫能否通过拼图的魔法互相学习呢？

[来自[url=https://nomnomnami.itch.io/charm-studies]itch.io[/url]]
